text_en: Now as an elder myself and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, as well as one who shares in the glory to be revealed, I exhort the elders among you
text_cn: 所以我这同为长老的，为基督苦难作证的，以及同享那将要显示的光荣的人，劝勉你们中间的众长老：

text_en: to tend the flock of God that is in your charge, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion but willingly, as God would have you do it —not for sordid gain but eagerly.
text_cn: 你们务要牧放天主托付给你们的羊群；尽监督之职，不是出于不得已，而是出于甘心，随天主的圣意；也不是出于贪卑鄙的利益，而是出于情愿；

text_en: Do not lord it over those in your charge, but be examples to the flock.
text_cn: 不是做托你们照管者的主宰，而是做群羊的模范：

text_en: And when the chief shepherd appears, you will win the crown of glory that never fades away.
text_cn: 这样，当总司牧出现时，你们必领受那不朽的荣冠。

text_en: In the same way, you who are younger must accept the authority of the elders. And all of you must clothe yourselves with humility in your dealings with one another, for “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble. ”
text_cn: 同样，你们青年人，应该服从长老；大家都该穿上谦卑作服装，彼此侍候，因为“天主拒绝骄傲人，却赏赐恩宠于谦逊人。”

text_en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, so that he may exalt you in due time.
text_cn: 为此，你们该屈服在天主大能的手下，这样在适当的时候，他必举扬你们；

text_en: Cast all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.
text_cn: 将你们的一切挂虑都托给他，因为他必关照你们。

text_en: Discipline yourselves, keep alert. Like a roaring lion your adversary the devil prowls around, looking for someone to devour.
text_cn: 你们要节制，要醒寤，因为，你们的仇敌魔鬼，如同咆哮的狮子巡游，寻找可吞食的人；

text_en: Resist him, steadfast in your faith, for you know that your brothers and sisters in all the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
text_cn: 应以坚固的信德抵抗他，也该知道：你们在世上的众弟兄，都遭受同样的苦痛。

text_en: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, support, strengthen, and establish you.
text_cn: 那赐万恩的天主，即在基督内召叫你们进入他永远光荣的天主，在你们受少许苦痛之后，必要亲自使你们更为成全、坚定、强健、稳固。

text_en: To him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
text_cn: 愿光荣与权能归于他，至于无穷之世。阿们。

text_en: Through Silvanus, whom I consider a faithful brother, I have written this short letter to encourage you and to testify that this is the true grace of God. Stand fast in it.
text_cn: 我藉忠信的弟兄息耳瓦诺，给你们写了这封我认为简短的书信，为劝勉你们，并为证明这实在是天主的恩宠：在这恩宠上你们应该站稳。

text_en: Your sister church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings; and so does my son Mark.
text_cn: 与你们一同被选的巴比伦教会问候你们；我儿马尔谷也问候你们。

text_en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
text_cn: 你们要以爱的亲吻，彼此问候。愿平安与在基督内的你们众人同在。
